description.value: The bard plays a single tune of his instrument or holds a note with their voice, a small shockwave of sound bursting forth. This sound follows a straight path from the bard until it hits a solid surface and then rebounds back to the bard, the bard knows the exact distance between him and the object the sound hit. Rebound sound can penetrate liquids, finding the total depth of a body of water, or the bard can lower the power of the tune to stop if it would hit a liquid.
